verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a SaaS data platform with a CLI and SDKs, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never documents a way to disable telemetry or usage tracking. The usage-related items describe the opposite: audit logging, lineage tracking and budget usage monitoring, none of which is an opt-out control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
